name: probit-trees-p2
description: Does probit-widen-p1b's cold routing gain hold when trees train and play at ply 2? F-P x2 against T-P-Nc-merge limit 4, threshold 1M, fresh merge gate, --split-noise 0.03 (p1b's best arm) x2, in a pure ply-2 field (entry_ply 2, ply1_entries false, self-games, no references), 12 rounds a cycle, scaled plateau with min_cycles 200. Standard tournament (T 0.1) as in p1b, so the ply is the one factor against it; the verdict is a T 0.02 arena of every line's final version at ply 2 and 1 (make_cold_read.py --final). The analyst's plan (theory-2 6.11), launched 11-11 ~01:05; T 0.1 in the tournament instead of the drafted T 0.02, to keep one factor against p1b.
